note: Machine-readable map of the documentation. `authority` says what an agent may do with a document: binding rules, the current state, an implementation record, an audit of a past tree, a plan, a decision or a reference. Only `current` documents carry numbers about today; `planning` documents never do.

authorities.binding: rules of the repository; violating them is a defect
authorities.current: describes the tree as it is today
authorities.record: what was implemented, with the command and the result
authorities.audit: an observation of the tree at a date; history
authorities.planning: a plan, never a claim about the tree
authorities.decision: an ADR: the reason of a choice and what it rules out
authorities.reference: a specification or a procedure the code must satisfy
